description: This file contains a Lua script for a graphical application that initializes a window, loads an image, and animates it bouncing within the window boundaries while displaying position information.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the graphical window and loads the image logo.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles drawing the background, the image at current position, displaying position info, and updating the position with bouncing logic.
